samples.name: Streaming example
samples.description: The same decoder fed in fragments through dz/feed; output is drained with dz/read.
samples.output_text: Streaming means the decoder accepts compressed bytes in fragments, keeps its bit and Huffman state, and resumes without reconstructing it. This sample is fed in deliberately awkward chunks:  !"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~.

samples.name: Binary bytes
samples.description: Binary output including NUL and every byte value; shown as hex.

samples.name: Empty output
samples.description: A valid DEFLATE stream whose decompressed result is zero bytes.

samples.name: gzip-wrapped text
samples.description: A single-member gzip container around raw DEFLATE.
samples.output_text: This sample uses the gzip container. The browser adapter only removes the gzip header and trailer; the DEFLATE payload is decoded by Glon.
